summary: Frontend testing of micro-animations, currency converter redesign, and service success page features. ALL TESTS PASSED.

Hero buttons have pulse animations on icons, shimmer effects on hover, and spring animations working correctly
TransfersHub.js has transfer cards with data-testid attributes (transfer-card-local, transfer-card-international) and enhanced hover animations
CurrencyConverterSection.js redesigned with premium custom dropdown components, animated swap button, and result display with animations
ServiceSuccess.js includes QR Code (using qrcode.react), WhatsApp contact block with link, and payment proof upload functionality
Theme toggle (dark/light mode) works correctly on all updated components
MOCKED: Payment proof upload in ServiceSuccess.js is simulated (no actual backend endpoint)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: Hero section 4 buttons with micro-animations, TransfersHub cards with animations, Currency Converter premium redesign, ServiceSuccess page with QR Code, WhatsApp link, and proof upload. Theme toggle works on all pages.
